description: This Java class implements the <call-simple-method> element for a mini-language processing framework within the Apache OFBiz project. It handles invoking simple methods defined in external XML resources, managing execution scope, and mapping results to fields.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod
classes.description: Implements the <call-simple-method> element, managing invocation of simple methods, handling scope, and result mapping.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod.CallSimpleMethodFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CallSimpleMethod.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod.ResultToField
classes.description: Inner class for mapping results from the called simple method to environment fields.

methods.name: CallSimpleMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element and simple method context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the call to the simple method, manages scope, handles errors, and maps results.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information related to the called simple method.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method to call.

methods.name: getXmlResource
methods.description: Returns the XML resource location of the simple method.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the call-simple-method element.
